summary: Validity of Rule 21(8) of Punjab VAT Rules, 2005; rule introduced during gap in enabling statute (25.01.2014–01.04.2014); no power to restrict ITC on stock to reduced tax rate without legislative backing; retroactive effect on concluded transactions; High Court's declaration upheld; rule ultra vires; impugned notification invalid.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab Value Added Tax Act, 2005 s.13(1)
Punjab Value Added Tax Act, 2005 s.70(1)
Punjab Value Added Tax Act, 2005 s.8(3)
Punjab Value Added Tax Rules, 2005 r.21(8)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding writ petition affirmed; Rule 21(8) inserted vide notification dated 25.01.2014 declared ultra vires and invalid.
